name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 28, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Deacon Ron Arnold of St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of the "People's Choice" Certificate to Sheryl Tempchin for the New Dimensions Art Exhibit
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Proposition 84 Storm Water Grant Program - Paseo Santa Fe Green Street Project - Revised Resolution (CC)
C4.
2012/2013 Citizen's Option for Public Safety Grant Program Second Quarter Allocation (CC)
C5.
Donation of Funds for the Junior Deputy Program (CC)
C6.
Changes to Commissions, Boards, and Committees (CC)
1.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California Amending Chapter 2.18 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding General Provisions and Requirements Affecting City Commissions, Boards and Committees."
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.44 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Parks and Recreation Commission."
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.46 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Public Arts Commission."
4.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.48 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Planning Commission."
5.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.56 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Senior Citizens Affairs Commission."
6.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.58 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Youth Advisory Commission."
7.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.60 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Traffic Commission." (Recommended Action continued on following page)
8.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 2.76 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding the Mobile Home Review Board."
9.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the amendment of City Council Policy No. 200-06, Appointments to City Boards, Committees and Commissions.
10.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the amendment of City Council Policy No. 200-12, Student Participation on City Committees and Commissions.
C7.
Collection of Delinquent 2012 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent weed abatement charges.
2.
Set June 11, 2013, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2013 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2012 weed abatement charges.
C8.
Levy of Special Tax for Community Facility Districts for Fiscal Year 2013/14 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , levying a special tax in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 92-1 (North County Square) for FY 2013/14.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , levying a special tax in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 90-2 (Hacienda Drive and Buena Vista Creek) for FY 2013/14.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , levying a special tax in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 2000-1 (Hacienda Gateway Restructuring) for FY 2013/14.
C9.
Janitorial Services Agreement for Civic Center (CC)
C10.
Recreation & Community Services Field Tournament Fee (CC)
C11.
Amendment to Vista Municipal Code - Use of City Seal and Letterhead (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Draft FY 2013/14 Operating Budget (CC/BSD/CDC)
D2.
Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and Fiscal Year 2013/14 Capital Project Budget (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and FY 2013/14 Capital Project Budget and authorizing appropriations for FY 2013/2014 Capital Projects.
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and FY 2013/14 Capital Project Budget and authorizing appropriations for FY 2013/2014 Capital Projects.
3.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and FY 2013/14 Capital Project Budget and authorizing appropriations for FY 2013/2014 Capital Projects.
4.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Five-Year Capital Improvement Program and FY 2013/14 Capital Project Budget and authorizing appropriations for FY 2013/14 Capital Projects.
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for the 2012/13 fiscal year and approving the allocation of 2012/13 fiscal year interest earnings to individual capital project budgets, and approving adjustments to reported TransNet cash balances between authorized SANDAG projects on the FY 2012/13 TransNet Schedule A.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
